standard: Confirmed identity only: same artist, title identical on the museum record, sale not before the work, printed dimensions in agreement with the museum object, generic repeated titles excluded. See scripts/build-sales-picture-matches.py.

rejected.subject: Adoration of the Shepherds
rejected.reason: The Met object is a small drawing (pen and brown ink, 9 13/16 x 8 3/16 in., Rogers Fund 1966). The 1790 sale entry gives no medium, no dimensions, no price and no buyer, and Jordaens treated the Adoration of the Shepherds repeatedly, in paint and on paper. Nothing in either record ties this sheet to that sale.
